title: Reliable video evidence and witness export
details: Actions are now written after recording as one text box for the whole LO or KSB section
The live camera is no longer rebuilt when competence decisions or ACs change, improving long-recording stability
Video capture now targets 720p at a higher bitrate and requires a live microphone track before recording starts
Linked witness testimony reuses the signed observation and only asks for the witness signature
Witness videos are added to the same complete evidence package instead of being left in a separate ZIP
Video PDFs have been rebuilt with readable evidence cards, grouped mapping, clear actions and signatures
Exports still package original stored videos directly and never replay or transcode them
